papers.title: MOS: Towards Effective Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection through Mixture-of-Experts Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.abstractOneWord: 用混合专家微调大模型检测并解释智能合约漏洞，对象是 Solidity 合约。
papers.abstract: 智能合约漏洞会给区块链系统带来严重安全风险，也可能造成大额资金损失。现有方法有几处不足：程序分析依赖预先写好的模式，难以及时覆盖新漏洞类型；深度学习方法往往给不出检测结果的解释；基于大语言模型的方法误报偏高。本文提出 MOS：先在大规模智能合约数据上做持续预训练，再对大模型做混合专家微调。作者用大模型生成、再经专家核对，构造高质量微调数据，让模型在检出漏洞时给出解释；并设计面向漏洞的路由，按代码特征激活最相关的专家网络。持续预训练后的前馈层被扩展成多组并行专家，分别对应重入、时间戳依赖、整数溢出/下溢、delegatecall 等模式；训练时用双重目标，一边优化检测与解释，一边用专家负载的熵约束，让不同类型漏洞分到相应专家。实验显示，相对已有最好方法，F1 平均提高 6.32%，准确率平均提高 4.80%；解释质量在正确性、完整性和简洁性上，3 分或 4 分（4 分制）的比例分别为 82.96%、85.21% 和 94.58%。
papers.abstractEn: Smart contract vulnerabilities pose significant security risks to blockchain systems, potentially leading to severe financial losses. Existing methods face several limitations: (1) Program analysis-based approaches heavily rely on predefined patterns, lacking flexibility and adaptability to new vulnerability types; (2) Deep learning-based methods lack explanations for their detection results; (3) Large language model-based approaches suffer from high false positive rates. To address these challenges, we propose MOS, a smart contract vulnerability detection framework based on mixture-of-experts tuning (MOE-Tuning) of large language models. First, we conduct continual pre-training on a large-scale smart contract dataset to provide a domain-enhanced initialization for the subsequent MOE-Tuning process. Second, to provide reliable explanations for detected vulnerabilities, we construct a high-quality MOE-Tuning dataset through a multi-stage pipeline combining large language model generation and expert verification. Third, we design a vulnerability-aware routing mechanism that activates the most relevant expert networks by analyzing code features and their matching degree with experts, addressing the limitation of predefined patterns in program analysis approaches. Finally, we extend the feed-forward layers of the LLM after continual pre-training into multiple parallel expert networks, each specializing in specific vulnerability patterns. We also employ a dual-objective loss function: one for optimizing vulnerability detection and explanation performance, and another for ensuring reasonable distribution of different vulnerability types to corresponding experts through entropy calculation of expert load distribution, thereby improving model performance in complex vulnerability scenarios. Extensive experiments show that MOS significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods with average improvements of 6.32% in F1 score and 4.80% in accuracy. The vulnerability explanations generated by MOS also demonstrate high quality, achieving positive ratings (scores of 3 and 4 on a 4-point scale) of 82.96%, 85.21% and 94.58% for correctness, completeness, and conciseness, respectively, through a combined approach of human evaluation and LLM evaluation.

papers.title: VulDec: Vulnerability Detection in Binaries via Neural Decompilation
papers.abstractOneWord: 用大模型做神经反编译，再检测二进制漏洞，对象是多架构 C 二进制。
papers.abstract: 二进制可执行文件往往没有源码，汇编层能用的语义也有限，自动漏洞检测因此很难。机器学习代码分析已有进展，但仍缺少同时覆盖汇编与源码、并带精确漏洞标签的大规模高质量数据。本文提出 VulDec：一是新的大规模数据集，把真实世界的汇编–C 函数对与多架构 CWE 标注对齐；二是首个用神经反编译做二进制漏洞检测的端到端框架。在该数据上微调的基于大模型的神经反编译器，跨架构源码恢复的 Edit Similarity 约 56%、BLEU-4 约 43%；微调后的大模型检测器在漏洞率约 3% 的分布内真实测试集上，宏平均 F1 为 0.61。结果表明，神经反编译可以替代传统低层二进制表示，支撑更稳的二进制漏洞检测。
papers.abstractEn: Automated vulnerability detection in binary executables is challenging due to the lack of source code and the limited semantic information available at the assembly level. Despite significant progress in machine-learning-based code analysis, the field still lacks methodologies and large, high-quality datasets that provide vulnerable code jointly at assembly- and source-level with precise vulnerability labels. To address this gap, we introduce VulDec, consisting of (i) a new large-scale, carefully curated dataset aligning real-world Assembly-C function pairs with detailed CWE annotations across multiple architectures, and (ii) the first end-to-end framework that leverages neural decompilation for binary vulnerability detection. Tuned LLM-based neural decompilers trained on our dataset achieve strong source-level recovery across architectures (Edit Similarity of approximately 56%, BLEU-4 of approximately 43%), while our tuned LLM-based detectors reach a macro F1-score of 0.61 on an in-distribution realistic test set (3% vulnerability rate). Our findings provide evidence that neural decompilation offers a powerful alternative to conventional low-level binary representations, facilitating robust binary vulnerability detection.

papers.title: CIVER: Causal Intervention Verification for Reliable Code Review
papers.abstractOneWord: 用因果干预核验大模型代码审查结果、压低误报，对象是仓库级软件代码。
papers.abstract: 代码审查用来找缺陷、提高代码质量。编码智能体写的提交越来越多，用大模型做代码审查也越来越常见。但大模型审查意见往往又长又碎，里面有不少误报或缺少证据的说法，会误导开发者和后续智能体。本文提出 CIVER，用因果干预判断审查意见是否对应真实缺陷。它包含三个模块：审查模块评估发现，干预模块生成面向修复的扰动，核验模块给审查可靠性打分。三个模块通过专家迭代联合优化：对针对该缺陷的修复应改变判断，对无关改动应保持稳定。在 SWE-Review-Bench 上，CIVER 能通过定向修复正确识别 77% 的真实缺陷；跨项目和后续修复实验还显示，它能泛化到其他仓库，并提高编码智能体的任务成功率。
papers.abstractEn: Code review is essential for maintaining software repositories by identifying defects, improving code quality, and supporting reliable software evolution. With the growing adoption of LLM-based coding agents, an increasing number of code contributions and repository changes are generated by these agents. Consequently, LLM-based code review agents are becoming increasingly prevalent to evaluate these contributions and maintain software quality. However, LLM reviewers often generate lengthy reviews containing numerous potential issues, many of which are false positives or lack sufficient evidence. These unreliable reviews can mislead developers and downstream coding agents, motivating the need to distinguish actionable findings from unsupported claims. We propose CIVER, a causal intervention-based framework that identifies the core issues underlying code-review findings and distinguishes genuine defects from false positives. CIVER integrates three modules: a review module assesses findings, an intervention module generates repair-oriented perturbations, and a verifier module scores review reliability. Through joint optimization via expert iteration, the three modules identify genuine defects by responding to targeted repairs while remaining stable under unrelated changes. Extensive experiments on SWE-Review-Bench demonstrate that CIVER correctly identifies 77% of genuine defects through targeted repairs. Cross-project and downstream repair evaluations further demonstrate that CIVER generalizes across repositories and improves coding agents' task success rates, highlighting its effectiveness for reliable automated code review.

papers.title: Beyond QASecClaw: Agent Scaling, Verifier Feedback, and Evidence Reliability in Software Assurance
papers.abstractOneWord: 评估增加大模型智能体上下文能否提高软件安全保障，对象是 Java 告警、OWASP 与 Defects4J。
papers.abstract: 在已经有确定性工具证据的前提下，再增加专门的大模型上下文，能不能提高软件安全保障？本文用五项实验来回答：手写的 Java 告警控制、OWASP Benchmark 评估、Defects4J 测试生成、SV-COMP 断言判定，以及故意误导的证据包。系统基于 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct，并做了 1.5B 的敏感性分析，共完成 13,638 次模型请求。在 8 个相关开发告警上，上下文从 1 个加到 50 个，token 用量增加 49 倍，但不安全放行没有改善。在 160 个 OWASP 案例上，不同配置在放行与未决之间权衡，10 上下文一组只评了 96 例。在 32 个 SV-COMP 任务上，原始验证器反馈把平均正确判定从 12.7 提到 22.0，错误判定也从 1 升到 7；JBMC 加 JVM 的基线则是 26 个正确、6 个未决。在两套各 120 个证据包上，模型拒绝了 70% 到 100% 本应适用的反例，而按构造范围做的检查能全部判对。三个 Defects4J 缺陷中没有发现目标缺陷，其中一个测试适配器还不支持。这些描述性结果表明，在所测设定里应优先采信确定性证据，同时也暴露了判定汇总、反馈理解和评测覆盖的局限。
papers.abstractEn: Can additional specialist language-model contexts improve software assurance when deterministic tool evidence is already available? We study this question through five experiments spanning authored Java warning controls, OWASP Benchmark assessment, Defects4J test generation, SV-COMP assertion verdicts, and deliberately misleading evidence packages. The evaluated systems use Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, with a 1.5B sensitivity analysis, and complete 13,638 model requests. On eight related development warnings, increasing the context count from 1 to 50 increases token use 49-fold without improving unsafe clearance. On 160 OWASP cases, model configurations trade clearance against unresolved outcomes; the ten-context arm assesses only 96 cases. On 32 SV-COMP tasks, raw verifier feedback raises mean correct model verdicts from 12.7 to 22.0, but also raises incorrect verdicts from one to seven; a JBMC-plus-JVM validation baseline returns 26 correct verdicts and six unresolved outcomes. On two sets of 120 evidence packages, models reject 70-100% of applicable counterexamples, while construction-specific scope checks classify every package correctly. No target defect is discovered in three Defects4J bugs, one unsupported by the test adapter. These descriptive results support deterministic evidence admission for the tested settings, while exposing limits of verdict aggregation, feedback interpretation, and the available evaluation coverage.

papers.title: From Instructions to Exploits: Applying Program Analysis to Malicious Agent Skills Across Natural Language and Code
papers.abstractOneWord: 用大模型把技能说明书编成中间表示，再静态分析恶意智能体技能，对象是编码智能体的第三方技能包。
papers.abstract: 大模型智能体越来越依赖第三方技能，这些技能把自然语言说明和可执行代码捆在一起，供应链风险可能同时出现在这两类材料里。现有技能扫描多靠规则匹配或直接让大模型下判断，很难追踪跨域行为。本文提出面向智能体技能的供应链扫描器 SCS：用一组有限的安全向 API，把自然语言说明编译成受约束的 Python 风格中间表示，再分别为说明和附带代码建程序依赖图，连成跨域图 xPDG；随后用信任–敏感度–能力（TSC）模型在图上传播安全属性，做结构化、大体可确定的风险检测。在人工核对的 117 个恶意和 117 个良性技能基准上，五种大模型平均准确率 85.6%、召回 95.2%、F1 86.9%，精度 80.2%，平均消耗 1370 万 token；自然语言到中间表示的编译在 400 个标注步骤上，步骤正确率为 92.5% 到 94.5%。对 66,157 个真实 ClawHub 技能分析后得到 2,473 个候选，经动态验证和人工复核确认 627 个恶意技能。
papers.abstractEn: LLM-powered agents increasingly rely on third-party skills that combine natural-language instructions with executable code, creating supply-chain risks that may span both artifacts. Existing skill scanners often rely on rule matching or direct LLM judgments and provide limited support for tracing such cross-domain behavior. We present the Supply-Chain Scanner for Agent Skills (SCS), a static analysis framework that unifies instructions and code for security analysis. SCS compiles natural-language instructions into a constrained Python-style intermediate representation using a limited set of security-oriented APIs. It then constructs program dependence graphs for instructions and bundled code and connects them into a cross-domain graph (xPDG). A Trust-Sensitivity-Capability (TSC) model propagates security properties over the graph to support structured, largely deterministic risk detection. On a manually verified benchmark of 117 malicious and 117 benign skills, SCS achieves the highest average accuracy (85.6%), recall (95.2%), and F1-score (86.9%) among evaluated methods across five LLMs, with 80.2% precision and average token consumption of 13.7 million. Its NL-to-IR compiler achieves 92.5%-94.5% step-level correctness on 400 human-annotated instruction steps. Finally, analyzing 66,157 real-world ClawHub skills yields 2,473 candidates, of which 627 are confirmed malicious through auxiliary dynamic validation and manual review.

papers.title: An EVM-Cosmos Bridge for Atomic, Semantic-Preserving Transfer of Environmental Tokens
papers.abstractOneWord: 设计保持语义且原子转移的 EVM–Cosmos 跨链桥，并用模型检验检查不变量，对象是异构链上的环境类代币。
papers.abstract: 在 EVM 与 Cosmos 这类异构链之间转移带语义类型的代币，会碰到两个问题：语义混用，即代币在途中丢掉领域含义（例如不同方法学签发的二氧化碳移除量）；以及在共识和时序假设不同时仍要保证原子性。本文提出一座同时处理这两点的桥：由密码学承诺导出确定性的指标身份，在两边链的类别登记中镜像，并在铸造时检查，从构造上避免语义混用。原子性方面，把哈希时间锁合约从双方兑换扩展成单所有者转移，在目的链领取后自动回调销毁源链托管，并用协议最低赏金，使回退销毁即使面对恶意发送方也满足激励相容。作者用 TLC 机器检查协议不变量（没有理性监视假设时供给守恒不成立，有该假设时成立），并在 Polygon 与 Neutron 主网、经 Axelar GMP 验证双向原型：Polygon 到 Neutron 的 50 次全自动转移，7 天中位端到端时延 97 秒（全部由链上自动回调完成），反向 93 秒，语义校验开销不到消息费用的 0.4%。文中还记录了 Cosmos 侧发起消息的集成失败模式，主要运行风险是中继资格而不是时延。
papers.abstractEn: Transferring semantically typed tokens between heterogeneous blockchains (e.g. EVM and Cosmos ecosystems) raises two problems: semantic mixing, the loss of a token's domainspecific meaning in transit (e.g., CO2 removals issued under different methodologies), and atomicity despite divergent consensus and timing assumptions. We propose a bridge that addresses both. A deterministic indicator identity derived from cryptographic commitments, mirrored in class registries on both chains and checked at mint time, preventing semantic mixing by construction. For atomicity, we extend hash time-locked contracts (HTLCs) from two-party exchange to single-owner transfer with an automatic callback that burns the source escrow after a destination claim, and a protocol-minimum bounty that makes the fallback burn incentive-compatible even against adversarial senders. We machine-check the protocol's invariants with TLC (supply conservation fails without the rational-monitor assumption and holds with it) and validate a bidirectional prototype on Polygon and Neutron mainnets over Axelar GMP: fully automatic transfers with a median end-to-end latency of 97 s over 50 Polygon to Neutron transfers across 7 days (all completed by the on-chain automatic callback) and 93 s in the reverse direction, and semantic-validation overhead below 0.4% of messaging cost. We also document the integration failure modes of Cosmos originated messaging, whose dominant operational risk proves to be relay eligibility rather than latency.

papers.title: UniPCH: A Unified Framework for Cross-Chain Payments via Payment Channel Hubs
papers.abstractOneWord: 提出分层跨链支付通道中枢，并给出抗 griefing 与原子性安全分析，对象是 UTXO 与账户模型链。
papers.abstract: 支付通道中枢可以做隐私跨链支付，但现有协议很难扩到异构链上：支付流程往往绑死某条链如何表示交易、如何授权通道更新、如何结算；有的协议甚至没说明通道如何在真实链上实现。要支持新账本或执行模型，就要重新实现通道，还可能要改协议并重做安全分析。本文提出 UniPCH，用两层把本地通道执行和隐私跨链支付逻辑分开。下层 UniPC 定义共同状态迁移和安全要求，并把任务授权与完整通道状态确认分开；作者给出 UTXO 账本和带智能合约的账户账本实现。上层用选择性重签盲条件签名（S-RBCS）协调各中枢的条件授权，据此构造四阶段支付协议。分析给出局部 UniPC 安全、抗 griefing、经济原子性和会话不可链接性。Go 原型在不同网络条件和参数下测量各阶段运行时间与带宽：公共接口带来的计算开销不大，多数配置在有网络时延时比对照方案更快；完整刷新消融显示，账户实现里复用仍有效的任务证据可以降低计算和通信开销。
papers.abstractEn: Payment channel hubs (PCHs) enable private cross-chain payments, but existing protocols remain difficult to extend across heterogeneous blockchains. Their payment flows often depend on how particular blockchains represent transactions, authorize channel updates, and settle balances. Some protocols do not explain how their channels are implemented on actual blockchains. Supporting a new ledger or execution model requires a corresponding channel realization and may also require protocol adaptation and security analysis. We present UniPCH, a framework with two layers that separates native channel execution from private cross-chain payment logic. The lower UniPC layer defines common state transitions and security requirements. It separates task authorization from confirmation of the complete channel state. We provide realizations for UTXO ledgers and account ledgers that support smart contracts. At the upper layer, we develop selective re-signing blind conditional signatures (S-RBCS) to coordinate conditional authorization across hubs. Using S-RBCS, we construct a payment protocol that coordinates different channels in four phases. Our analysis establishes local UniPC security, griefing resistance, economic atomicity, and session unlinkability. We implement a Go prototype and evaluate the running time and bandwidth of each phase under different network conditions and system parameters. Results show modest computational overhead from the common interfaces. Most evaluated configurations run faster than comparable schemes under network delay. A full refresh ablation shows that reusing valid task evidence reduces computation and communication costs in the account realization.

papers.title: On the Subtleties of Non-Malleability in IVC: Notions, Attacks and Constructions from Falsifiable Assumptions
papers.abstractOneWord: 分析增量可验证计算的非延展性，给出攻击并构造带模拟可靠性的 IVC，对象是零知识证明与增量证明系统。
papers.abstract: 增量可验证计算（IVC）的非延展性讨论还不多。本文关心：在可证伪假设下，能否以及如何得到模拟可靠的 IVC。作者进一步说明增量证明的非延展性有其特殊性：形式化模拟可靠 IVC 时定义并不好写；现有从可证伪假设出发的 IVC 设计，若不改构造，也不能“免费”带上模拟可靠性。除了一族新的模拟可靠 IVC 定义，主要结果有两点。否定方面：常见的 Valiant 风格证明是可延展的。作者抽出 Valiant 风格 IVC（TCC 2008）里与合并证明有关的共同特征，并证明：只要有单向函数，这类设计的自然零知识版本就可延展。由此，目前唯一从可证伪假设得到的 NP 上 IVC（Datta 等，CRYPTO 2025）无法满足任何形式的模拟可靠性，即便构件换成非延展的也不行。肯定方面：在亚指数不可区分混淆，以及亚指数 LWE 或亚指数双线性映射假设下，构造了满足一种非平凡模拟可靠性的 IVC。这是首个带非延展性特征、且基于可证伪假设的 IVC。
papers.abstractEn: We investigate non-malleable Incrementally Verifiable Computation (IVC), a subject that has received limited attention. We focus on whether and how simulation-sound IVC can be obtained from falsifiable assumptions. We provide additional evidence of the unique aspects of non-malleable incremental proofs, identifying definitional challenges in formalizing simulation-sound IVC, and showing how existing IVC designs from falsifiable assumptions cannot exhibit simulation-soundness "for free" (without modifications). In addition to a new family of definitions of simulation-sound IVC, our main results are the following. - A general negative result: common Valiant-style proofs are malleable. We isolate and formalize a feature shared by the dominant Valiant-style IVC designs (Valiant, TCC 2008) related to the ability to merge proofs together. We show that, assuming one-way functions, natural zero-knowledge versions of Valiant's design are malleable. As an implication of our framework of attacks, we show that the only IVC for NP from falsifiable assumptions (Datta et al., CRYPTO 2025) cannot satisfy any form of simulation-soundness; this is the case even when instantiating this scheme from non-malleable building blocks. - A positive result: first IVC from falsifiable assumptions with non-malleability features. We construct an IVC satisfying a non-trivial form of simulation-soundness under subexponential iO and either subexponential LWE or subexponential bilinear-map assumptions.

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Undisclosed Charges in Hook-Based Decentralized Exchanges
papers.abstractOneWord: 用字节码分析测量 Uniswap v4 等 Hook 未披露的结算扣费，对象是以太坊与 BSC 上的 AMM 合约。
papers.abstract: 许多去中心化交易所用自动做市商相对流动性池成交。新一代 AMM 允许第三方合约 Hook 定制这一过程，Hook 可以额外扣费，而按标准池参数列出的费用明细并不会单独写出这部分。据作者所知，这是对生产环境 Hook 生态未披露结算扣费的首次大规模经验研究，覆盖 Uniswap v4 与 PancakeSwap Infinity 在以太坊和 BSC 上截至 2026 年 8 月 1 日的 7,873 个 Hook、50,011 个池和 2.96 亿条池事件。作者用字节码分析还原 Hook 如何改写交易者的收付款，把扣费与兑换资产、标准手续费分开，再还原历史结算以测量扣费频率和经济负担。直接改结算是最常见的 Hook 能力，占已注册 Hook 的 71.37%。扣费能力很普遍，也经常被用：24.30% 的 Hook 能施加未披露扣减，这类 Hook 参与且可核算的兑换中有 59.23% 发生了扣减。有价格数据的 Hook 累计收入约 397 万美元。结果说明标准费用展示和真实交易成本之间有缺口，有必要把 Hook 扣费与标准手续费一并明确披露。
papers.abstractEn: Many decentralized exchanges use automated market makers (AMMs) to trade assets against liquidity pools. Modern AMMs allow third-party contracts, called Hooks, to customize this process. However, Hooks can impose additional deductions that fee breakdowns based on standard pool parameters do not itemize. We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first large-scale empirical study of the production Hook ecosystem, focusing on these undisclosed settlement charges. Our study covers 7,873 Hook deployments, 50,011 pools, and 296M pool events on Uniswap v4 and PancakeSwap Infinity across Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain (BSC) through August 1, 2026. We develop a bytecode analysis that reconstructs how Hooks change traders' payments and receipts, separating charges from exchanged assets and standard fees. We then reconstruct historical settlements to measure charging frequency and economic burden. We find that direct settlement adjustment is the dominant Hook capability, supported by 71.37% of registered Hooks. Charging capability is widespread and often exercised: 24.30% of Hooks can impose undisclosed deductions, and these deductions occur in 59.23% of accounted swaps involving such Hooks. These charges generate millions of dollars in revenue, with $3.97M recorded across Hooks with available token prices. These findings reveal a gap between standard fee displays and actual trading costs, motivating explicit disclosure of Hook deductions alongside standard fees.
